description: This file defines the Smarty_Internal_Compile_Break class, which is a plugin component for the Smarty template engine. It compiles the {break} tag used within Smarty templates, handling the logic to generate the corresponding PHP code that manages loop control flows such as break levels in Smarty templates.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Compile_Break
classes.description: A class responsible for compiling the {break} tag in Smarty templates, handling levels of loop exit and restoring foreach states as necessary.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Generates the PHP code for the {break} tag, considering specified levels and managing foreach loop restore.

methods.name: checkLevels
methods.description: Validates and determines the break levels and corresponding foreach loop levels based on the tag attributes and current template stack.
